name: bot-hq
description: Bot HQ: a team of remote Hermes Agents with local screens and xAI voice.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run build -w server && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/agent-health.mjs tests/bot-archive.mjs tests/computer-keys.mjs tests/events.mjs tests/hermes-approvals.mjs tests/identity.mjs tests/jitsi-invite.mjs tests/message-actions.mjs tests/model-choice.mjs tests/owner-email-*.mjs tests/owner-secrets-flow.mjs tests/personal-assistant-flow.mjs tests/personal-gmail-transport.mjs tests/reset-queue.mjs tests/routine-autopause.mjs tests/routine-chat.mjs tests/routine-schedule.mjs tests/screen-bench.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
